rule: EXACT SAME M7.5 selection/age/physics/checkpoint/arms/120-step endpoints and identical gate thresholds, only held-out numeric seeds change

heldout.source_world: M7.3 no_transfer, 264 original native particles in 24x24 periodic grid, cost_move=1, no catalysis, 16 dispersed energy sources, all initial bonds absent
heldout.selection: First eligible naturally generated maximal connected native component, 5..16 member particles, >=4 original chemical bonds, >=1 spare valence member, >=2 unique originally present material pair bonds with at least 20 uninterrupted post-step snapshot ages. Reset age for a break even if same-tick reform; choose lowest sorted material tuple at earliest selected tick. No replacement for null source worlds.
heldout.initial_states: Exactly identical whole-world full hash/RNG/energy/IDs/bonds at selected source fork
heldout.first_step_invariant: Exact same original material source bond break pairs at fork tick+1 on all arms

endpoints.primary: Coherent t120 source growth: same native bonded component includes ALL original selected material IDs plus at least one external material ID, not necessarily never-broken source edges.
endpoints.secondary: No actual source ORIGINAL bond break EVENTS over the full t1..120 fork, even if reformed later.
endpoints.reporting: Source selection proportion; components' size and tree/cycle type; exact paired discordant counts, incident source material chemical bond forms, original flow, net boundary energy, global bond births; 5 fixed checkpoints and full ledger.
endpoints.independent_unit: Numerical source-world seed, NOT the 3 associated arms or per-tick observations
endpoints.primary_gate: UNCHANGED M7.5: >=40 eligible numeric seed worlds, >=25 discordant bond_only vs no_transfer outcomes, >=2/3 favorable bond_only among discordant pairs.
endpoints.secondary_gate: UNCHANGED M7.5: same minimum 40 and 25 and >=2/3 favorable for original bond nonbreak.
endpoints.failure: Record not_met_or_underpowered without adjusted thresholds, extra seeds or alternative favorable endpoints.
